interpretation.plain_speak: Move the 'cold' label to a different set of facts and the losses move with it. STORE, OBSERVE, REPORT, quin, or rue do not matter; lack of recent use does. When four facts are equally cold and two slots are needed, the existing table order chooses which two go.
interpretation.north_star_question: Identifies the durable-store retention signal under lexical integration—recent reuse—without adding capacity or semantic priority, providing a mechanistic basis for future bounded memory management.
interpretation.next_stage: stagger last-access time across durable lexical cohorts before identical admissions to map the graded recency ordering and separate recency priority from equal-recency table-order tie breaking
